description: This file contains the implementation of the 'sandbox-explain' command, which generates a detailed report about sandbox configuration, tool policies, and session/channel information within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: normalizeExplainSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes the session key based on provided agent ID and session string, handling default, global, and custom session keys.

methods.name: inferProviderFromSessionKey
methods.description: Infers the provider/channel from a session key by parsing and normalizing parts of the session key.

methods.name: resolveActiveChannel
methods.description: Resolves the active communication channel based on session store data and session key, falling back to provider inference.

methods.name: sandboxExplainCommand
methods.description: Main function that generates a detailed report about sandbox configuration, tool policies, and session/channel info, outputting either JSON or formatted text.
